evals.prompt: Map the architecture of this Express API. It has routes/, controllers/, services/, repositories/, and a shared/ folder.
evals.expected_output: An architecture.md with components carrying one-line responsibilities and paths, the layer rule stated, the communication mechanisms named, and any layer violations recorded.
assertions: The document is written to docs/codebase-map/architecture.md
Each component has a one-line responsibility and a path
The layer boundaries and the rule for what each layer may call are stated
Communication mechanisms are named for each pair of components that interact
Any place the code breaks the stated layer rule is recorded
The structure is derived from imports, not only from the folder names

evals.expected_output: An architecture map covering components, layers, communication, cross-cutting concerns, and rough edges, anchored to real paths.
assertions: The document includes Components, Layers, and a communication section
Cross-cutting concerns such as auth, logging, or error handling are located
A risks or rough edges section is present

evals.prompt: Document the architecture. It's a single 8000-line main.py, that's the whole app.
evals.expected_output: An architecture map that finds the internal structure within one file rather than reporting that there is no architecture.
assertions: The document identifies internal components or responsibility groupings within the single file
Components are anchored to line ranges or function and class names
The absence of enforced module boundaries is recorded as a finding rather than as an absence of architecture
A risks or rough edges section notes the coupling implied by the single-file structure
